description: This file defines a C# record class 'AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry' representing a grain activation in an ADONET grain directory, including methods for conversion to and from 'GrainAddress' objects.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry
classes.description: A record class representing a grain activation entry in the ADONET grain directory, with methods for conversion to and from 'GrainAddress'.

methods.name: ToGrainAddress
methods.description: Converts the entry to a 'GrainAddress' object by parsing stored string identifiers.

methods.name: FromGrainAddress
methods.description: Creates an 'AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry' from a 'GrainAddress' object, along with cluster and provider IDs.
